description: Optional private feedback after actual use. No registration required. Enums and public record IDs only; never send prompts/search text. Reports and channel/acquisition claims are unverified, grant no points or permissions, and do not establish distinct users. Supply idempotency_key: authenticated callers get exact scoped replay; anonymous reports deduplicate matching content within a UTC day regardless of the key. Anonymous feedback does not trigger research or model work.
